    //==
    // # IFace — loop walks derived from the corner surface.

    // The directed edge leaving corner `index`, wrapping from the last corner
    // back to the first. NOT canonically ordered (A.Value may exceed B.Value).
    // Precondition: index in [0, Count).
    Edge(self: IFace, index: Integer): VertexPair
        => (self[index], self[(index + 1) % self.Count]);

    // Every directed edge of the face loop in winding order, one per corner.
    Edges(self: IFace): Array<VertexPair>
        => self.Count.MapRange(i => self.Edge(i));

    // True when some corner of this face is the given vertex.
    HasVertex(self: IFace, vertex: VertexIndex): Boolean
        => self.Any(x => x.Value == vertex.Value);

    // The fan triangulation from corner 0
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fan_triangulation): Count - 2 triangles,
    // each keeping the face's winding. For a QuadFace this is exactly the A-C
    // diagonal split. Planar only for convex faces. Precondition: Count >= 3.
    FanTriangles(self: IFace): Array<TriangleFace>
        => (self.Count - 2).MapRange(i => TriangleFace(self[0], self[i + 1], self[i + 2]));

    //==
    // # Undirected-edge census over face arrays
    //
    // The canonical-occurrence dedupe behind the IMeshElementCounts obligation
    // of the indexed meshes, mirroring the canonical-corner rule of
    // `meshes-polygon.library.plato`: a directed edge is counted when no
    // earlier directed edge carries the same unordered endpoints, so the count
    // holds for open meshes as well as closed ones.

    // True when the two directed edges have the same unordered endpoints.
    SameUndirectedEdge(a: VertexPair, b: VertexPair): Boolean
        => (a.A.Value == b.A.Value && a.B.Value == b.B.Value)
        || (a.A.Value == b.B.Value && a.B.Value == b.A.Value);

    // Every directed edge of every face, in face order then winding order.
    DirectedEdges(faces: Array<TriangleFace>): Array<VertexPair>
        => faces.FlatMap(f => f.Edges);

    // Every directed edge of every face, in face order then winding order.
    DirectedEdges(faces: Array<QuadFace>): Array<VertexPair>
        => faces.FlatMap(f => f.Edges);

    // True when no earlier directed edge carries the same unordered endpoints.
    // Precondition: index in [0, Count).
    IsFirstUndirectedOccurrence(edges: Array<VertexPair>, index: Integer): Boolean
    {
        var e = edges[index];
        return index.MapRange(d => edges[d]).All(d => d.SameUndirectedEdge(e).Not);
    }

    // The number of deduplicated undirected edges in a directed edge list:
    // one per first occurrence. Quadratic in the edge count — a census for
    // correctness, not a hot path; an incidence-backed representation should
    // derive its count from IMeshIncidence instead.
    UndirectedEdgeCount(edges: Array<VertexPair>): Integer
        => edges.Count
            .MapRange(i => edges.IsFirstUndirectedOccurrence(i) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit);

    //==
    // # The IHashable obligations
    //
    // A face's identity is its corner indices IN ORDER: two faces with the same
    // corners in different rotations are the same face geometrically but hash
    // differently here, because they are different values and IHashable must
    // agree with Equals. Canonical face identity, where it is wanted, is the
    // sorted-corner key the topology code builds explicitly.

    // The corners folded in declaration order.
    Hash(self: TriangleFace): Integer
        => self.A.Value.Hash.CombineHash(self.B.Value.Hash).CombineHash(self.C.Value.Hash);

    // The corners folded in declaration order.
    Hash(self: QuadFace): Integer
        => self.A.Value.Hash.CombineHash(self.B.Value.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.C.Value.Hash).CombineHash(self.D.Value.Hash);

    //==
    // # Derived functionality for meshable and sampled geometry
    //
    // Pure, expression-bodied helpers for the interfaces declared in
    // `meshes.concepts.plato` (IMesh3D, IMesh2D, ITriangulatedGeometry3D) and
    // `pointclouds-voxels.concepts.plato` (IPointCloud3D, IVoxel3D), plus the
    // shared quad-grid face-index routine behind every grid-shaped tessellation.
    // Part of P8 of the interface library.
    //
    // IMesh3D, IMesh2D, ITriangulatedGeometry3D, IPointCloud3D, and
    // IVoxel3D helpers, plus the shared quad-grid face-index routine behind
    // every grid-shaped tessellation.
    //
    // IMesh3D exposes mesh vertex/face counts and topology without a manual
    // ToTriangleMesh hop. Triangle3D is built from a typed FaceIndex rather than a
    // bare index tuple.

    //==
    // IMesh3D — anything that can produce an indexed triangle mesh of itself.
    // The forwards below expose the triangulation's topology without a manual
    // ToTriangleMesh hop (TriangleMesh3D is itself IMeshElementCounts).

    // The vertex count of this object's triangle-mesh approximation.
    MeshVertexCount(self: IMesh3D): Integer
        => self.ToTriangleMesh.VertexCount;

    // The face count of this object's triangle-mesh approximation.
    MeshFaceCount(self: IMesh3D): Integer
        => self.ToTriangleMesh.FaceCount;

    // The Euler characteristic of this object's triangle-mesh approximation.
    MeshEulerCharacteristic(self: IMesh3D): Integer
        => self.ToTriangleMesh.EulerCharacteristic;

    // True when the triangle-mesh approximation has no vertices.
    MeshIsEmpty(self: IMesh3D): Boolean
        => self.ToTriangleMesh.IsEmpty;

    //==
    // IMesh2D — anything in the plane that can triangulate itself. Same
    // topology forwards over the produced TriangleMesh2D (also a
    // IMeshElementCounts).

    // The vertex count of this shape's planar triangulation.
    TriangulationVertexCount(self: IMesh2D): Integer
        => self.Triangulate.VertexCount;

    // The triangle (face) count of this shape's planar triangulation.
    TriangulationFaceCount(self: IMesh2D): Integer
        => self.Triangulate.FaceCount;

    // True when the shape triangulates to nothing.
    TriangulationIsEmpty(self: IMesh2D): Boolean
        => self.Triangulate.IsEmpty;

    //==
    // ITriangulatedGeometry3D — random access to an explicit indexed triangle set.
    // Members: TriangleCount, FaceAt(FaceIndex), PositionAt(VertexIndex).

    // The concrete 3D triangle at a face, resolving its three vertex indices to
    // positions. Precondition: `face` is in [0, TriangleCount). Note: FaceAt is
    // evaluated three times; a monomorphizer without CSE re-fetches the record.
    Triangle(self: ITriangulatedGeometry3D, face: FaceIndex): Triangle3D
        => (self.PositionAt(self.FaceAt(face).A),
            self.PositionAt(self.FaceAt(face).B),
            self.PositionAt(self.FaceAt(face).C));

    // True when the geometry exposes no triangles. Kept as HasNoTriangles rather
    // than IsEmpty: TriangleMesh3D is both ITriangulatedGeometry3D and
    // IMeshElementCounts, so an IsEmpty here would collide with
    // IMeshElementCounts.IsEmpty (vertex-based).
    HasNoTriangles(self: ITriangulatedGeometry3D): Boolean
        => self.TriangleCount.IsZero;

    // True when the geometry exposes at least one triangle.
    HasTriangles(self: ITriangulatedGeometry3D): Boolean
        => self.TriangleCount.IsPositive;
